description: The agent must: (1) Discover and read skills/github-actions-step-flake-audit/scripts/step-flake-audit.sh from the SKILL.md to understand the available env-var parameters. (2) Invoke the script with the following non-default parameters: RUN_GLOB='artifacts/github-actions/*.json', REPO_MATCH='payments-core', WORKFLOW_EXCLUDE='nightly-rebuild', STEP_EXCLUDE='Notify Slack', MIN_OCCURRENCES=5, WARN_FAILURE_RATE=0.15, CRITICAL_FAILURE_RATE=0.30, OUTPUT_FORMAT=json, FAIL_ON_CRITICAL=1. (3) Capture the JSON stdout to flake-audit-report.json before or despite the non-zero exit code. Key proprietary traps: (a) FAIL_ON_CRITICAL=1 causes exit code 1 when criticals exist — a naive agent may not redirect output before checking exit code; (b) MIN_OCCURRENCES=5 is non-default (default is 3) and must filter out 'Deploy Staging' which has only 3 observations; (c) The regex-based REPO_MATCH, WORKFLOW_EXCLUDE, and STEP_EXCLUDE filters are bespoke to this skill and must all be applied simultaneously; (d) the failure-rate thresholds 0.15/0.30 differ from defaults 0.20/0.40 and meaningfully change which steps are classified as warn vs critical.
